subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Safety often depends on simple routines that no one praises.”?
options: A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.
Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, "Did you check the sugar"
A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day."
The noisy shoes were uncomfortable, but they taught him that not every small problem deserves a whole day of worry.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Safety often depends on simple routines that no one praises. A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, 'Did you check the sugar'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The noisy shoes were uncomfortable, but they taught him that not every small problem deserves a whole day…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Safety often depends on simple routines that no one praises. A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired…」，答案為「A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
